aboutPage.quote: Christie has convinced me that every large analytics reporting transformation engagement needs a designer at the table. She brings a fresh design-led approach so our teams can build dashboards people actually want to use.
Christie quickly understands the client ask, gathers requirements, and proactively suggests better customer experience options while aligning closely with developers on what is possible.
Christie is a highly capable designer who can be trusted to independently work on an assignment with minimal oversight and guidance.
Christie consistently delivers designs that exceed client expectations, with strong collaboration across distributed teams and a clear commitment to continuous improvement.
